en: Add every order on Orders and its products on Order Lines. Totals, promised days, days to ship and late checks fill in.
mt: 添加 Orders 中的每个订单及其在 订单行 上的产品。填写总计、承诺天数、发货天数和逾期检查。

en: Hello {customer}, your refund of {refund_amount} for return {return_id} was sent on {refund_date}. It can take a few days to show in your account.
mt: {customer} 您好，您的退货 {return_id} 退款已于 {refund_date} 寄出。可能需要几天时间才会显示在您的帐户中。
